response.courseDescription: 403 Advanced Cropping Systems Understanding the management of constraints to crop production and quality; biological, physical, and chemical approaches to crop health management. Field trips required. Recommended preparation: CROP SCI 305; PL P 429. (Crosslisted course offered as CROP SCI 403, CROP SCI 503, PL P 403, PL P 503.) Credit not granted for both CROP SCI 403 and 503, or PL P 403 and 503. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
